notes: Interactive AI-workflow milestone: AIDao now connects its safe provider abstraction to the on-device workspace. Projects can generate structured plans from the saved brief and conversation, edit generated requirements, track implementation tasks, preserve task progress, regenerate plans from new context, share a project specification, and see truthful build-readiness states. The default provider remains the offline AIDao Local Planner, and source generation or APK claims are not shown as complete until they are actually connected and verified. Android-native insets, Discord-inspired workspace styling, readable functional typography, and the user-controlled update path remain preserved.
